edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your snare with Trickster, attaching the shark, and one-shotting you before the reflect matters.
